report_note: REPORT.md write refused; orchestrator reconstructed it. 6 harnesses + fixtures on disk (untracked).
exposure: brief/schema files; round4/D11/{dora_keys,d11lib,governance_cost}.py (enumerators + GOV only); policy_lint.mjs, web-fix-wave.js, cfr_exclusions.json, governance.yml, tests.yml; GitHub records. No D11 finding read; round3/round5 not opened.

findings.title: Every rework round in the window is head-moved re-verification, and the class that names it is never used
findings.claim: Over v6.6.0..e336cc2c, 11 of the window's 74 parseable review verdicts are rework; all 11 name a head sha other than that merge's first verdict's; the class web-fix-wave.js defines for exactly that, head-moved, has 0 verdicts; and blocked verdicts number 1, of class claims, with 0 engineering-blocking verdicts.
findings.mechanism: The grammar's merge arm is the PASSING verdict, so the re-verification fixer.md steps 2-8 force after any rebase/merge is spelled merge, never blocked head-moved, even though the class exists. policy_lint --stats INFO line says passing verdict 'counts rework nowhere. Friction is rework.'

evidence.unit: extra review rounds naming a moved head (of 11 over 7 of 67 merges)
evidence.machine: shared audit box, darwin 25.6.0; counts not timings

perturbation.change: D13_FIXTURE=fixtures/reshaped.json reshapes one rework verdict; second arm D13_WAVE deletes the merge alternative from VERDICT_RE
perturbation.observed_value: reshaped: extra_rounds 11->10; no-merge arm: rounds 74->1, no-verdict 4->66

findings.metric_definition: a merge's second-or-later parseable verdicts whose named head sha differs from that merge's first parseable verdict's

null_control.note: the fixture carries the same fetched records

findings.proposed_fix_scope: emit blocked <sha> head-moved: on a moved head, or count a second merge on a different head as rework in statsHistogram; do not widen VERDICT_RE

findings.title: Six per cent of the window's merges carry no verdict, all automation-authored, and the histogram's denominator is 64
findings.claim: 4 of the 67 merges (0.060) carry no parsable verdict (#1358, #1362, #1261 hpo-author[bot], #1257 hpo-approver[bot]), while policy_lint --stats reports merge 63 + claims 1 = denominator 64; no rule exempts an automation-authored PR from the verdict beat.
findings.mechanism: The histogram prints the population it saw, not the merges the window contains.

evidence.unit: merges with no parsable verdict, of 67 (0.060)
evidence.machine: shared audit box; counts not timings

perturbation.change: D13_FIXTURE=fixtures/covered.json gives the first verdict-less merge a merge comment; opposite arm reshaped removes a parseable verdict
perturbation.observed_value: no-verdict 4->3, yield 0.925->0.940; opposite arm leaves count at 4

findings.metric_definition: merges_with_no_parsable_verdict / merges, over merges first-parent in the window
findings.proposed_fix_scope: print a coverage line beside STATS: the counts the histogram saw vs the window's merge count

findings.title: The change-failure exclusion list is keyed where the excluded job cannot gate a merge
findings.claim: Keyed on the merge commit, excluding record moves CFR to 0.090 (6/67), but record is skipped at 67/67 PR heads and fails 58/67 merge commits; keyed at the PR head the failing names are nightly-status 7/67 and delivery-status 2/67, neither excluded, so the head rate is 0.134 and stays 0.134 with the exclusion applied.
findings.mechanism: The list removes a job that never runs where merges are gated.

evidence.unit: CFR at the PR head, unexcluded names (0.090 at the merge commit)
evidence.machine: shared audit box; counts not timings

findings.metric_definition: cfr_head_any_excl = share of merges with an unexcluded check run concluding failure at the merged PR head sha
findings.proposed_fix_scope: report both keyings; do not add nightly-status to the list

non_findings.claim: verdict grammar not bypassed in practice (1/75 outside, the one --stats flags)
no verdict delivered only as a PR review
GOV set has not drifted (8 jobs)
two governance jobs cost a PR nothing
exclusion list not dead weight (record 58/67 at merge commit)
friction resolver not ambiguous (35/45 name one file)
top friction key is the fixer contract
